Subject: Feedback + Next Steps: Asha Singh (SWE IC4) interview loop

Team — quick debrief on Asha. We wrapped the loop yesterday afternoon; overall strong technical breadth but we saw a couple of product-fit questions where she was thinner. Please: (1) drop your scorecards in GH by EOD today, (2) flag any blocking concerns in reply here, and (3) mark if you want to call for a quick follow-up system-design probe (10–20m). Recruiting will wait on a final consensus before moving to reference checks.

Key reminders for your scorecard entry: 1-5 across Technical Design, Systems, Ownership, Communication. If you mark a 2 or below on Technical Design or Ownership, add a one-line justification.

Attached: my quick notes and the GH link below. I’ll synthesize after we have all scores.

Attachments: asha_singh_scorecard.pdf (summary stub)
Links: https://greenhouse.io/12345-application

Thanks —
Karthik

- Ownership: 4

Karthik — scorecard uploaded and attaching my notes here. TL;DR: strong debugging and pragmatic design but limited ownership examples for cross-team projects. I gave a 3 on Ownership and left detail in the notes.

Notes excerpt:
- Example A: explained bug triage but didn’t quantify impact reduction or cross-team coordination steps (missing stakeholder map)
- Example B: described leading a small infra project but didn’t cover rollout/rollback plan clearly

Attachment: mina_interview_notes.docx (interview notes, redacted)

If the committee wants to be conservative we can ask for a short 15-minute behavioral follow-up focused on cross-team execution. Otherwise I’m OK to proceed to references if others are comfortable.

Best,
Mina
Engineering Manager

Thanks all — posted my scores. Quick summary: Technical Design 4, Systems 4, Ownership 3, Communication 4. My only hesitation is Ownership parity with other IC4 hires; Mina’s point about the rollout plan resonates.

Proposal to move us to a quick consensus: if two of four panelists (including hiring manager) mark Ownership <= 3, we schedule the 15-minute behavioral follow-up; if not, start reference checks and target an offer comp discussion. Can we confirm hiring manager (if not on this thread) weight?

Also opened a short poll in the GH thread to capture a yes/no to follow-up so we have an explicit count.

—Jonas

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Feedback + Next Steps: Asha Singh (SWE IC4) interview loop

Folks — thanks for the quick turn. We have 3 of 4 panelists in and the poll shows 2/3 wanting a short behavioral follow-up on cross-team ownership. Per Jonas’ rule let’s run the 15-minute probe. Recruiting: please schedule a 15-minute slot with Asha this week (preferable Thursday AM Pacific) and send a brief prompt doc to the panel: 1) walk through a cross-team rollout you led, 2) how you prioritized stakeholders, 3) one thing you would do differently next time.

Action items: 
- Recruiting (recruiting@talenthook.com): schedule 15-min follow-up by Thu 2026-09-17 (ASAP) and update GH status.
- Mina: please draft 3 quick probe questions for the panel by EOD today.
- Marissa & Jonas: be prepared to join if available; otherwise we’ll take notes and reconvene after the short probe.

If the follow-up goes well, we’ll move to reference checks and target an offer discussion next week. If it raises concerns, we’ll close the loop here.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, SWE Hiring Ops
